title: Remembering Allah While Waiting
paragraphs: Sitting anxiously in a hospital waiting room while his mother underwent a minor surgery, Bilal found himself checking the clock every few minutes, unable to focus on anything else.
An elderly man sitting beside him, noticing his restlessness, gently suggested that quiet remembrance of Allah often helped him personally during long, uncertain waits like this one.
Bilal decided to try it, softly repeating simple phrases of remembrance under his breath instead of staring anxiously at the clock or refreshing his phone repeatedly.
To his surprise, the waiting time felt slightly more bearable, not because it passed faster, but because his mind felt calmer and less consumed by worst-case scenarios.
When the doctor finally came out with good news, Bilal thanked the stranger for the simple suggestion, realizing that small acts of remembrance could genuinely ease anxious waiting.
